x_hardening: In agentbox/web.py, note_login_failure() tracks login failure counts in memory (fails['suppressed']). x_hardening: web.py _shown checks isinstance(value, str); while all current template contexts pass strings or string-returning filters, any future template that directly renders a custom object relying on __str__ would bypass escape_controls (though HTML autoescape would still apply). Passing str(value) through escape_controls for all non-None values would eliminate this type-dispatch sensitivity.

Unicode combining marks (category Mn/Me, including Zalgo stacking and Variation Selectors U+FE00..U+FE0F, U+E0100..U+E01EF) and Private Use Area characters (Co) are intentionally not in _ESCAPED to allow legitimate international and symbol text; while they cannot alter Bidi directionality or execute ANSI control codes, stacking combining marks can cause visual font overflow in browsers and terminals. Capping repetitive combining sequences would provide visual hardening.
